pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chattupāhanaṃ dhārenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo chattupāhanaṃ dhāressanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhoginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chattupāhanaṃ dhāressantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī chattupāhanaṃ dhāreyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.1.15: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.2: tassā vinā chattupāhanaṃ na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.5: evañ ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:1.2.6.1: yā pana bhikkhunī agilānā chattupāhanaṃ dhāreyya, pācittiyan ti. ||2||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.1.8: yassā vinā chattupāhanaṃ na phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.1.10: tīṇi chattāni setachattaṃ kilañjachattaṃ paṇṇachattaṃ maṇḍalabandhaṃ salākabandhaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.1: agilānā agilānasaññā chattupāhanaṃ dhāreti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.4: chattaṃ dhāreti na upāhanaṃ, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc84:2.2.5: upāhanaṃ dhāreti na chattaṃ, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
